overview.title: Results
overview.description: Items returned by the SocialCrawl API call. Rows are read from the exact path the registry declares for the endpoint (`data.items[]`, `data.author`, `data.post`…), and `_sc_item_kind` names the canonical object each row is. Credit and request metadata are attached on each row under `_sc_`-prefixed fields (`_sc_credits_used`, `_sc_credits_remaining`, `_sc_request_id`, `_sc_cached`, and `_sc_page` when auto-paginating). On a row-joined call (`include=…`) the API's hydration receipt rides along as `_sc_hydration_*` — rows attempted and filled, credits held and kept, and the time the join added. The complete, untouched API envelope is also saved to the run's key-value store as OUTPUT.
